title: Claire Expands Its Computing Power Map: Anthropic Collaborates with Riot to Achieve a $9.1 Billion Long-Term Cooperation Agreement

content_html:
The arms race in the field of artificial intelligence is advancing into the infrastructure of computing power. According to insiders, the AI company Anthropic has recently signed a major computing power deal worth up to $9.1 billion with Riot Platforms Inc., a cloud computing company that has transitioned from Bitcoin mining.

As an important step in its business transformation, Riot Platforms Inc. has officially entered the field of artificial intelligence data center computing power services. According to the information it disclosed, the two parties have finalized a 20-year deep cooperation agreement, under which Riot Platforms Inc. will provide a total of 191 megawatts of power capacity through its modernized campus in Rockdale, Texas, to support the computing power needs of this leading AI company's large-scale models.

Industry experts point out that as competition among major AI model manufacturers for underlying computing power intensifies, transforming traditional energy and cryptocurrency mining companies' high-performance campuses into AI data centers has become a new trend in solving computing power bottlenecks. This long-term and significant cooperation not only provides Anthropic with long-term and stable computing power support for technological iteration, but also marks the accelerating integration of the AI industry with traditional energy infrastructure.

content_html_zh:
人工智能领域的军备竞赛正在向算力基础设施推进。 据内部人士透露，人工智能公司 Anthropic 最近与 Riot Platforms Inc. 签署了一项价值高达 91 亿美元的算力交易，Riot Platforms Inc. 是一家从比特币挖矿转型的云计算公司。

作为其业务转型的重要一步，Riot Platforms Inc.正式进军人工智能数据中心算力服务领域。 据其披露的信息，双方已敲定一项为期20年的深度合作协议，根据该协议，Riot Platforms Inc.将通过其位于德克萨斯州罗克代尔的现代化园区提供总计191兆瓦的电力容量，以支持这家领先的AI公司大规模模型的算力需求。

业内专家指出，随着各大AI模型厂商对底层算力的竞争加剧，将传统能源和加密货币挖矿公司的高性能园区改造为AI数据中心已成为解决算力瓶颈的新趋势。 此次长期且意义重大的合作，不仅为Anthropic提供长期稳定的技术迭代算力支撑，也标志着人工智能产业与传统能源基础设施的加速融合。
